question.html:
a.i In the Bohr model for the hydrogen atom orbital angular momentum is quantized  . Outline the effect this has on the electron energy. [1]

a.ii For the hydrogen atom, the orbit radius of the electron in the = 2 state is four times larger than the orbit radius in the = 1 state. Determine the ratio  of the electron speed in the  = 2 state to the speed in the  = 1. [2]

b Compare and contrast the Bohr prediction for the radius of an electron orbit in hydrogen to that of the description of the electron in terms of a wave function. [2]

c Determine, using the uncertainty principle, the minimum kinetic energy of a neutron inside a nucleus of radius 3 × 10−15 m. [2]
